The source opens with: A **Hom module** \(\mathrm{Hom}_R(M,N)\) is the set of all [[algebra-modules/module-homomorphism|module homomorphisms]] \(f\colon M\to N\) between \(R\)-[[algebra-modules/module|modules]], equipped with pointwise addition \((f+g)(m)=f(m)+g(m)\). This makes \(\mathrm{Hom}_R(M,N)\) an abelian group. If \(R\) is a [[algebra-rings/commutative-ring|commutative ring]], then \(\mathrm{Hom}_R(M,N)\) is naturally an \(R\)-module via \((r\cdot f)(m)=r\,f(m)\).
